2608.07196.title: EMAS: Stabilizing Multi-Agent System Evolution through Evidence-Guided Revision
2608.07196.paper_summary: Many methods for automated multi-agent system design optimize prompts and topologies during an initial design stage and then deploy the resulting system unchanged on subsequent samples. Experience from these samples is rarely consolidated into reusable system updates, while accuracy-oriented designs may incur high token costs. We introduce EMAS (Evolving Multi-Agent System), which uses this experience to revise MAS topology and prompts without updating LLM parameters, either to improve accuracy or to reduce cost. EMAS converts traces into structured diagnoses that specify a revision operation and target. It generates a candidate revision only when the same diagnosis recurs across samples and applies it only if paired validation against the current MAS meets the corresponding acceptance criterion. Across four benchmarks and two LLMs, EMAS attains the highest task-weighted overall accuracy for both backbones and is best or tied in six of eight model--benchmark settings. Within two evolution epochs, EMAS achieves relative gains of 6.30% and 20.10% in task-weighted accuracy on Kimi-K2-6 and Qwen3.6-27B, respectively. On MBPP with Qwen3.6-27B, EMAS raises accuracy from 55.09% to 89.12% while reducing token use per task by 62.2%. These results show that EMAS can turn experience from new samples into reusable updates to MAS topology and prompts.
2608.07196.paper_summary_zh: 許多自動化多代理系統設計的方法在初始設計階段優化提示和拓撲，然後在後續樣本上不變地部署結果系統。來自這些樣本的經驗很少被整合成可重用的系統更新，而以準確性為導向的設計可能會產生高昂的標記成本。我們介紹了 EMAS（演化多代理系統），它利用這些經驗來修訂 MAS 拓撲和提示，而不更新 LLM 參數，以提高準確性或降低成本。EMAS 將痕跡轉換為結構化診斷，指定修訂操作和目標。只有當相同的診斷在樣本中重複出現時，它才生成候選修訂，並僅在與當前 MAS 的配對驗證滿足相應的接受標準時應用它。在四個基準和兩個 LLM 中，EMAS 在兩個骨幹上達到了最高的任務加權整體準確率，並在八個模型--基準設置中的六個中表現最佳或並列最佳。在兩個演化世代內，EMAS 在 Kimi-K2-6 和 Qwen3.6-27B 上分別實現了 6.30% 和 20.10% 的任務加權準確率相對增益。在 MBPP 與 Qwen3.6-27B 上，EMAS 將準確率從 55.09% 提高到 89.12%，同時將每個任務的標記使用量減少了 62.2%。這些結果表明，EMAS 可以將來自新樣本的經驗轉化為可重用的 MAS 拓撲和提示更新。
